 Weather 
 Today's forecast 
 Get the latest weather updates from the NBC6 meteorologists. 
 By Adam Berg • 
 Published October 30, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 30, 2026 at 7:29 am 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 NBC6’s Adam Berg has your forecast for today, Friday, Oct. 30, 2026.
 Friday looks quite similar to the last couple of days… passing light showers, a slight breeze and warm conditions. We touched the upper-80s in spots the last couple of days and we will do it again today.
 King tides continue to slowly dissipate, but we are still technically under a coast flood advisory again on Friday. The next round of high tides are midday and into the early afternoon. King tide flooding will be slightly worse across the Keys as we are under a coastal flood warning.
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 Rain chances creep up from here with 50-60% of us seeing scattered storms this weekend. At this point in time Sunday looks more unsettled than Halloween. Stay with us as we continue to update you on the forecast.
 TODAY: Partly cloudy. Passing showers…isolated storm. Rain: 30%. High: 87°.
 SATURDAY: Scattered storms. Breezy. Rain: 50%. High: 85°.
 SUNDAY: Widespread storms. Breezy. Rain: 60%. High: 84°.
